content_sections.heading: WII Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the WII Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download WII Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: WII Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 11 vacancies are available - 3 for Project Associate I, 1 for Principal Project Associate, 1 for Senior Project Associate (Ecology), 1 for Project Associate II (Ecology), 3 for Project Assistant and 2 for Project Associate-I.

content_sections.heading: WII Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate I: Four Years Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Natural Sciences (Wildlife Science/Zoology/Ecology/Marine Sciences/Marine Biology/Environmental Sciences/Geoinformatics/Life Sciences)/Agricultural/Forestry Sciences. Principal Project Associate: Four Years Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Natural Sciences with 8 years of experience. Senior Project Associate (Ecology): Four Years Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Natural Sciences with 4 years of experience or Doctoral Degree. Project Associate II (Ecology): Four Years Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Natural Sciences with 2 years of experience or BVSc or B.Tech with 2 years of experience. Project Associate I: Four Years Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Natural Sciences or BVSc or B.Tech. Project Assistant: Bachelor's Degree in Natural Sciences or 3 years Diploma in Engineering. Project Associate-I: Master's Degree in Natural Sciences or BVSc. Project Assistant: Bachelor's degree in Science (Wildlife Science/Zoology/Ecology/Marine Science/Marine Biology/Environmental Science/Geoinformatics/Life Sciences/Agricultural/Forestry).

content_sections.heading: WII Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 50 years for all posts. Age Relaxation: SC/ST up to 5 years, OBC up to 3 years. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: WII Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on marks and experience Online Interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WII to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the WII Various Research Positions is 08 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies for Various Research Positions announced by the Wildlife Institute of India for the year 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for WII Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official website to fill out and submit their applications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the WII Various Research Positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment is 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Assistant post is Rs. 27,000 + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: For Project Associate I, candidates need a Four Years Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Natural Sciences or BVSc or B.Tech.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 500/-, while SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 100/- as a processing fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their marks and experience, followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for WII Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions at WII?
faq.answer: The positions advertised under WII Recruitment 2026 are contractual in nature.
